chunks: When they are told: 'Come to that which God has revealed, and to the Prophet,' you should see the hypocrites, how they hesitate and turn their faces away.
ai.seo_question: How do the hypocrites react when invited to the Quran and the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of the 'Invitation to the Quran and the Prophet' (Dawat al-Qur'an wa al-Rasul), highlighting the hypocrites' rejection of both the divine text and the specific authority of the Prophet (and by extension, the Ahl al-Bayt). Their decisive turning away (sudoodan) signifies a deep-seated spiritual blindness and resistance to the combined authority of revelation and prophetic leadership.
